title: How Jacky Chou made $261,661 in August 2025 by diversifying revenue and building in public
summary: Jacky Chou's August 2025 revenue update ($261.6k across SEO, SaaS, real estate, affiliates). He explains why he diversifies after losing ~95% of $500k/month affiliate and display ad income, and how building in public and doubling down on traction drive growth.

principles.text: Diversify revenue streams to insure against algorithm changes and platform risk.
principles.quote: Diversification is insurance against algorithm changes and platform risk.

principles.text: Never depend on one revenue source; algorithms can change overnight.
principles.quote: Do not rely on a single revenue source because algorithms can change overnight

principles.text: Building in public turns transparency into audience and launch trust faster than ads.
principles.quote: Reporting your wins publicly builds authority and audience faster than ads

principles.text: When a product shows traction, go all in on it.
principles.quote: When I see traction, I go all in.

principles.text: New projects can overtake old ones fast; LocalRank went from nothing to largest income stream in five months.
principles.quote: New projects can surpass old ones quickly. Five months ago LocalRank did not exist. Now it is my biggest income stream

principles.text: Balance the portfolio: stable assets for the long term, scalable software and SEO for growth, low-effort plays for bonus revenue.
principles.quote: Software and SEO products = scalable growth
